Package com.compdfkit.core.signature

Class CPDFExternalSignSession

java.lang.Object
com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFExternalSignSession
public final class CPDFExternalSignSession extends Object
Portable two-phase external signing using PDF Core's session format.

Initialize the SDK first. Calls are synchronous and should run on a worker thread. Prepare creates a new field with SubFilter adbe.pkcs7.detached and does not accept a PDF-open password. Existing documents/fields are not modified by the Java caller. The dedicated native document is released before returning.

The external service signs the returned digest and returns either a complete detached CMS container or a raw signature value. Persist the prepared PDF and complete session together. A different process can fill them without retaining the original document or a native handle. Keep both inputs unchanged.

This API does not automatically inject a timestamp or collect LTV material. A container provider can supply its own embedded timestamp. A completed PDF can receive a separate document timestamp through CPDFTimestampService.addDocumentTimestamp(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFTimestampOptions, com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFSignatureOptions).

Memory preparation and filling do not write PDF files. Optional post-fill validation uses the seekable backing described by CPDFSignatureValidator.validate(byte[], CPDFSignatureValidationOptions).

    • fillWithContainer

      public static CPDFExternalSignFillResult fillWithContainer(String session, String preparedPath, String outputPath, byte[] containerDer, CPDFExternalSignFillOptions options)
      Fills one complete detached CMS/PKCS#7 container into a prepared file.

      Use a DOCUMENT_DIGEST session. The container must be computed over the exact ByteRange content of this preparation. Capacity includes the entire CMS structure. A failed fill preserves the prepared file for retry.

      Parameters:
      session - the complete, unchanged Core session
      preparedPath - the exact prepared PDF; it may have moved since Prepare
      outputPath - a new output path, distinct from the prepared file
      containerDer - one detached SignedData DER value with signer information
      options - certificate/digest/verification settings; null uses defaults
      Returns:
      completion and independent verification results

    • fillWithSignatureValue

      public static CPDFExternalSignFillResult fillWithSignatureValue(String session, String preparedPath, String outputPath, byte[] signatureValue, CPDFExternalSignFillOptions options)
      Assembles a CMS container around an external raw signature and fills it.

      The qualified RSA contract is PKCS#1 v1.5 over the already-computed hashToSign. RSA-PSS parameters are not represented by this Core interface. SIGNED_ATTRIBUTES uses the certificate and attributes frozen in the session; DOCUMENT_DIGEST needs a certificate from Prepare or the fill options.

      Parameters:
      session - unchanged Core session
      preparedPath - exact prepared PDF
      outputPath - new output path, distinct from the prepared file
      signatureValue - raw signature bytes, not CMS and not Base64 text
      options - certificate and verification settings; null uses defaults
      Returns:
      completion and independent verification results

    • saveSession

      public static void saveSession(String path, String session) throws IOException
      Saves session text unchanged as UTF-8. The SDK does not create a second session format.
      Parameters:
      path - a new file in an existing directory
      session - nonempty Core session; this method does not validate its contents
      Throws:
      IOException - if writing fails or the destination already exists
      IllegalArgumentException - if the session is empty or contains NUL
